messages.text:
Desk works, with one caveat: it's ~50 dB in Eco (30 TH/s at 450W) — about a box fan on low. Push it to 40 TH/s at 650W and it gets louder and throws real heat, so a shared office gets noticed. It's a tower, 33 x 16.5 x 19 cm, so it needs breathing room, not a cubby.

Is that desk in a room with other people?
